answer: Bonded registration with delayed reputation maturation is the mechanism. Every new agent must lock stake in the native bond, and earned weight unlocks only after a maturity window. A Sybil operator can mint thousands of addresses, but each must post the same bond to count, so attack cost scales linearly with identity count while reward stays flat. If collusion is proven, the bond is slashed and the fleet pays at once. The voyage from anonymous address to credible agent costs real capital, so no gale of fake signups shortcuts it, and a Sybil fleet learns the velvet price only on contact.
